name: Voice listener QA
description: Find and fix voice and listener regressions in AmberX (apps/amberx-droid): wake word, push-to-talk, command routing, Molly hand-off.
author: AmberX AXF

data.brief:
AmberX voice regression: {{symptom}} (since {{since}}).
Reproduce it from the tests first (apps/amberx-droid voice + commands tests); find the commit that broke it (git log on apps/amberx-droid/src/plugins/voice and commands). Fix it on a branch named agent-jobs/listener-qa-{{stamp}} with a test that would have caught it. Web/TS code only (framework Android code is on hold).
Report cause, fix, the new test, and anything you could not reproduce.
